saved_trips.trip_title: Santorini Family Odyssey: Sun, Sea, and Ancient Wonders
saved_trips.general_summary: Embark on a luxurious 10-day family adventure in Santorini, immersing yourselves in the island's breathtaking volcanic landscapes, pristine beaches, and fascinating ancient history. This relaxed-paced journey balances exploration of Minoan ruins and charming villages with ample time for seaside enjoyment, creating unforgettable memories for all.

daily_summaries.title: Arrival in Paradise & Fira Charm
daily_summaries.summary: Settle into your luxurious Santorini accommodation and begin exploring the vibrant capital, Fira, with its caldera views.

daily_summaries.title: Ancient Akrotiri & Red Beach
daily_summaries.summary: Step back in time at the remarkably preserved Minoan settlement of Akrotiri, followed by a dip at the iconic Red Beach.

daily_summaries.title: Oia's Sunset Spectacle & Ammoudi Bay
daily_summaries.summary: Experience the world-famous sunset in Oia, and descend to the picturesque Ammoudi Bay for a fresh seafood dinner.

daily_summaries.title: Volcanic Beaches & Hot Springs
daily_summaries.summary: Explore the unique black sand beaches of Perissa or Kamari and take a rejuvenating boat trip to the volcanic hot springs.

daily_summaries.title: Pyrgos Village & Wine Tasting
daily_summaries.summary: Wander through the traditional, hilltop village of Pyrgos and enjoy a taste of Santorini's renowned wines.

daily_summaries.title: Caldera Cruise & Thirassia Island
daily_summaries.summary: Sail across the stunning caldera, visit the volcanic crater, and explore the quieter island of Thirassia.

daily_summaries.title: Relaxation & Beach Day
daily_summaries.summary: Enjoy a leisurely day at one of Santorini's beautiful beaches, perhaps the White Beach accessible by boat.

daily_summaries.title: Megalochori Charm & Local Flavors
daily_summaries.summary: Discover the charming traditional village of Megalochori, known for its unique architecture and local wineries.

daily_summaries.title: Museums & Firostefani Exploration
daily_summaries.summary: Visit the Museum of Prehistoric Thera in Fira and explore the scenic village of Firostefani with its iconic blue dome.

daily_summaries.title: Departure from Santorini
daily_summaries.summary: Enjoy a final Greek breakfast before departing from this magical island.
